paragraphs.title: Seventy Years of Subjugation and Babylon’s Commission

answers: The families of the north and Nebuchadrezzar

easy.q: Whom would the Lord bring against the land and the surrounding nations?

easy.explanation: The nations would serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
easy.q: How long would the nations serve the king of Babylon?

answers: The Lord would punish the king of Babylon
easy.explanation: After seventy years, the Lord would punish Babylon for its iniquity.
easy.q: What would happen after the seventy years were completed?

answers: Silenced joy, no weddings, no millstones, and no candlelight
medium.explanation: The voice of joy, weddings, millstones, and candlelight would cease.
medium.q: What signs of desolation are mentioned?

answers: Babylon had no part in the events
Being used as an instrument did not remove Babylon’s responsibility

paragraphs.title: The Shepherds’ Lament and the Ruin of the Pasture

answers: The shepherds and the principal of the flock
easy.explanation: The shepherds and leaders of the flock are called to lament.
easy.q: Who is called to howl and cry?

answers: They will find a place of escape
They will have no way to flee or escape
easy.explanation: The passage says the shepherds will have no way to flee and the leaders no escape.
easy.q: What will happen to the leaders?

easy.explanation: The Lord is described as having forsaken His covert like a lion.
easy.q: What animal image appears at the end of the passage?

answers: Their days of slaughter and dispersal have come

They are going out to conquer lands

answers: They are cut down because of the Lord’s fierce anger
